rebalance_policy: No daily rank replacement; only fill free slots, no pyramiding, three-session per-stock cooldown. Entry caps, not daily forced rebalancing.
ranking_policy: Prior-close 126-session relative total-return strength; descending, ticker ascending tie-break. No future selection.
membership_policy: Entries require prior-session eligibility; existing positions exit under the frozen signals/risk, not ranking changes.
missing_price_policy: No fill or signal price imputation; documented suspension may use an explicitly stale last valuation only. Unexplained gaps block. A held terminal security without proceeds evidence blocks publication.
price_model: Analytical provider-adjusted total-return units, raw OHLC for entry-lot reference and exchange-limit checks. Not a cash-dividend/reinvestment or broker-share execution reconstruction.
industry_policy: No historical sector cap claimed without point-in-time classifications; missing sector evidence blocks paper, not this explicitly limited diagnostic.

CN.universe: CSI300 historical monthly snapshot, lagged at least one session

tax_policy: CN gross provider-adjusted returns less a fixed conservative 20% of held ex-date cash dividends, booked at ex-date; not actual delayed holding-period settlement. US investor-specific withholding/capital-gain taxes excluded. Benchmarks retain their ETF tax treatment.
selection_policy: Keep all three entries, both fixed exits and base/stress costs; principal fixed before results. Retrospective diagnostic only, no OOS parameter selection.
